records.name: LiveRelay v1.0.0-beta.1 — 桌面重建与合并导入
records.provenance: First beta of the semantic-version series (MVP milestone naming retired). Android release built arm64-only from committed source 014f28f, application 1.0.0-beta.1+4, first release signed with the dedicated release key; older releases used the debug certificate, so upgrading from them requires uninstall/reinstall with an exported backup. Linux built inside an isolated Ubuntu 22.04.5 base rootfs from the verified script, full-ELF ABI audit plus an Xvfb smoke launch of the final bundle. Annotated tag is fixed at sourceCommit.
records.verification: 314 automated tests and desktop native suites (workbench 16, startup, close, transfer) passed; phone (Xiaomi 13) and emulator manual walkthroughs; APK manifest, single-ABI contents, and v2 certificate checked with aapt2/apksigner; full-ELF ABI audit of the Linux bundle (no debugger metadata); isolated Ubuntu 22.04 Xvfb smoke launch of the final bundle (app alive, Impeller and media_kit loaded; secret-service warning expected without a keyring); all 3 uploaded asset sizes/digests match local files. Windows, formal security review and more hardware remain unverified.

records.name: LiveRelay v1.0.0-beta.2 — 云端明文放行与摇篮
records.provenance: Android-only release built from committed source 2375f8c, application 1.0.0-beta.2+5, same dedicated release key as beta.1 (direct overwrite upgrade). Adds the cleartext-HTTP allowance for the IP+HTTP cloud, pins the integration_test dynamic dependency versions in android/build.gradle.kts so builds no longer need the network, and ships the cradle (check-in and auto handover) app side plus deploy assets; the cradle service runs on the ECS in dry-run mode pending SMTP credentials. Annotated tag is fixed at sourceCommit.
records.verification: 318 automated tests and static analysis; simulator A/B probe for cleartext HTTP (both configurations reach the cloud; evidence in work/artifacts/cleartext-ab-2026-10-15); phone (Xiaomi 13) real checks of cloud connection, check-in upload and cradle plan save; ECS cradle dry run (remind at 6.5d, notify at 11d, reset after re-check-in) plus a reminder drill against the owner's real record; the customer-volume discovery bug was found by the real record and fixed. APK manifest, single-ABI contents and v2 certificate checked with aapt2/apksigner; all uploaded asset sizes/digests match local files. SMTP delivery remains dry-run; two UI walkthroughs pending.

records.name: LiveRelay v1.0.0-beta.3 — Windows 适配与本机／远程交接分流
records.provenance: Android and Linux release built from committed source e89358d, application 1.0.0-beta.3+6, same dedicated release key as beta.1/beta.2. Windows adaptation is source-only in this release (Windows 11 build, startup and production-entry vault creation verified on Windows; no Windows binary attached). Linux built inside an isolated Ubuntu 22.04.5 rootfs via scripts/build_linux_ubuntu22.py with full-ELF ABI audit and an Xvfb smoke launch of the final bundle. Annotated tag is fixed at sourceCommit.
records.verification: Static analysis clean and 332 tests passed / 3 skipped; Android release built with the dedicated key, aapt2/apksigner verified package name, versionName, versionCode 6, arm64-only contents and v2 certificate; Linux built in the isolated Ubuntu 22.04.5 rootfs via scripts/build_linux_ubuntu22.py, full-ELF ABI audit passed, and the final bundle stayed alive in an Xvfb smoke launch (Impeller and media_kit loaded; expected secret-service warning without a keyring); QR payload and widget tests passed, no real-device scan walkthrough yet; all 3 uploaded asset sizes/digests match local files.

records.name: LiveRelay v1.0.0-beta.4 — 取件码交接与摇篮邮件
records.provenance: Android and Linux release built from committed source 273e0a7, application 1.0.0-beta.4+7, same dedicated release key as beta.1-beta.3. Default handoff is now a per-recipient password package (pickup code, editable email draft) with a recipient open flow; cradle plan v2 carries per-recipient subject/body and the server sends the owner draft. Linux built inside an isolated Ubuntu 22.04.5 rootfs via scripts/build_linux_ubuntu22.py with full-ELF ABI audit and an Xvfb smoke launch. Annotated tag is fixed at sourceCommit.
records.verification: Static analysis clean and 336 tests passed / 3 skipped; Android release built from 273e0a7 with the dedicated key, aapt2/apksigner verified package name, versionName 1.0.0-beta.4, versionCode 7, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, arm64-only contents and v2 certificate; Linux built in the isolated Ubuntu 22.04.5 rootfs via scripts/build_linux_ubuntu22.py, full-ELF ABI audit passed, no debugger native_assets.json in the archive, and the final bundle stayed alive for 20s in an Xvfb smoke launch (Impeller and media_kit loaded; expected secret-service warning without a keyring); cradle service dry run passed for v2 draft trigger and test mail; Android emulator layout walkthrough of the handoff list, add-recipient dialog and recipient detail page; all 3 uploaded asset sizes/digests match local files. Real ECS mail, real WebDAV upload from a phone, real-device package download/open, formal security review and Windows manual walkthrough remain unverified.
